releaseNotes.en:
## 1.6.17 Subagent Control & Long-Session Stability 🛡️

### Subagents

- Fixed subagent delegation failing permanently after its allowed models were cleared. (#643)
- Stopping a conversation now also cancels the subagents it dispatched. (#647)
- The Activity & Reminders panel now lists running subagents, and clicking one opens its details; clicking a conversation entry no longer opens a duplicate window. (#645)

### Context and requests

- Fixed a single oversized terminal output filling up the context and leaving the conversation unable to continue; stopping now also aborts an in-progress context compaction. (#652)
- Request timeouts now get their own message suggesting a longer timeout; the context-usage popover now follows the server-reported total, removing the mismatch between the usage percentage and the breakdown total. (#646)

### Review and progress feedback

- Improved the review view experience. (#622)
- Improved how collapsed multi-tool calls look.
releaseNotes.zh:
## 1.6.17 子 Agent 管控与长会话稳定性 🛡️

### 子 Agent

- 修复子 Agent 可用模型被清空后委派永久失败的问题。（#643）
- 停止会话时一并取消它派出的子 Agent。（#647）
- 活动与提醒面板列出运行中的子 Agent，点击直达详情；点击会话条目不再重复打开窗口。（#645）

### 上下文与请求

- 修复单条超长终端输出撑爆上下文导致会话无法继续的问题；停止时同时中止进行中的上下文压缩。（#652）
- 请求超时单独提示并引导调大超时；上下文用量弹层以服务端总量为准，消除占用百分比与明细总数的矛盾。（#646）

### 审阅与进度反馈

- 优化审阅视图的体验。（#622）
- 优化多工具调用折叠的样式表现。

releaseNotes.en:
## 0.1.4 Cross-Device Learning Data Sync 🔄

- Learning data (spaced-repetition state and Anki import journals) now lives in the visible `data/` directory inside your vault, so sync tools like Obsidian Sync can replicate your review progress across devices. Existing data is migrated automatically.
- Requires YOLO Core 1.6.5 or later, which performs the storage migration before the module activates.
releaseNotes.zh:
## 0.1.4 学习数据跨设备同步 🔄

- 学习数据（间隔重复状态与 Anki 导入日志）迁至 vault 内可见的 `data/` 目录，Obsidian Sync 等同步工具可跨设备同步复习进度；存量数据自动迁移。
- 需要 YOLO Core 1.6.5 及以上版本（Core 会在模块激活前完成存储迁移）。

releaseNotes.en:
## 0.1.0 In-House Engine 🚀

- Migrated the YOLO Whiteboard core to an in-house engine, greatly improving performance.
- Framed areas on scanned PDFs can now be connected, so you can jump from an annotation back to the area and see it highlighted. (#640)
- Ctrl/Cmd+V now pastes straight into the whiteboard, with text pasted as frameless text; unified the naming of "cards" and "text".
releaseNotes.zh:
## 0.1.0 自研引擎 🚀

- 将 YOLO 白板核心迁移为自研引擎，大幅优化性能表现。
- 白板扫描版 PDF 的框选区域支持连线，可从批注跳回原区域并高亮。（#640）
- 白板支持 Ctrl/Cmd+V 直接粘贴，文字粘贴为无框文字；统一「卡片 / 文字」命名。
